about_the_game:
Start with a small smoke shop, and build your path to a shadow empire.
Smoke Shop Simulator is a story-driven management and strategy game where legal business, advertising tactics, smuggling operations, bribery, and underworld connections collide.

🔹 Game Features

🛒 STAGE 1 – From Nothing to Something

Start in an empty shop. Set up display stands, order products via your computer, manage incoming shipments, and stock your shelves. Serve your first customers — but beware: your first police inspection comes on Day 3.

📣 STAGE 2 – Advertising and Popularity

Run social media campaigns or print out brochures with your in-store printer to attract local attention. Increase your shop’s popularity and grow your customer base.

💊 STAGE 3 – Enter the Underworld

Meet the Mexican cartel boss and unlock access to illicit products like coco, meth, and various cannabis seeds. Gain access to the secret farming zone behind your shop and begin your own shady cultivation.

🚨 STAGE 4 – Risk and Bribery Mechanics

As the stakes rise, border inspections become riskier. Products may be confiscated if you're caught. Use the dark web to buy information on police raid dates. Offer bribes or hide contraband — but be smart: cops have individual bribe tolerances, and if you get caught, there are serious consequences.

🏠 STAGE 5 – Luxury and Trouble

Buy cars, upgrade your home, and live the high life. But success brings enemies: local dealers may vandalize your shop or harass you. Call in cartel security to keep your empire safe.

🤝 STAGE 6 – Expansion and Delegation

Let NPCs run your shop or play online with up to 4 players. Expand your operation to multiple stores and build a full-scale smoke shop empire.

Smoke Shop Simulator
You started with tobacco. Can you end with an empire?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 550
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 31 GB available space
